title: Hearty Silky Canadian Pork Chops Skillet
description: A jammy and silky Canadian dish featuring pork chops and vegan-friendly ingredients, perfect for a show-off dinner party. This recipe combines the richness of pork with the sweetness of maple syrup and the earthiness of mushrooms.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the pork chops and cook for 5 minutes per side, or until they reach an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
Remove the pork chops from the skillet and set them aside to rest.
Add the sliced mushrooms and chopped onions to the skillet and cook until they are tender and lightly browned.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, or until fragrant.
In a small bowl, whisk together the maple syrup, salt, and black pepper.
Pour the maple syrup mixture over the mushrooms and onions in the skillet and stir to combine.
Return the pork chops to the skillet and spoon some of the maple syrup mixture over the top of each chop.
Sprinkle the chopped fresh thyme over the top of the pork chops and serve hot.
